notes: Vela v1.0 Pre-release (opt-in). New: 'safeboot' reboots with background services skipped, freeing RAM so a memory-heavy OS update can complete (safeboot, then update online, then reboot). Plus streamed pkg install and TLS-download heap handling for the Pico 2 W. Async multitasking shell by default; BLE + board auto-detect hardware-verified. Pre-release — please report bugs.
features: New: safeboot reboots without background services, freeing RAM for a memory-heavy OS update (safeboot -> update online -> reboot)
Fixed: pkg install streams the archive to flash (512-byte chunks) — no more MemoryError on large packages; a partly-extracted package registers no command
Large HTTPS installs reclaim heap before the TLS handshake; if the heap is too fragmented they now fail with clear guidance (install from a fresh boot) instead of a cryptic ENOMEM (Pico 2 W)
DEVELOPER BUILD — the v0.9.5 multitasking foundation, now the default experience
Multitasking shell is the DEFAULT — background services keep running while you work (classic sync shell stays as the recovery / crash fallback)
Background services: httpd start --bg / status / stop; service list/add/remove/test
Cooperative app framework (appkit) — a foreground app (e.g. sysmon) yields so it runs alongside background services
Full async line editor — history, Tab completion, cursor + word navigation (shared LineEditor with the classic shell)
Background scheduled tasks fire while idle (task background on); async-loop self-test (service test)
